sections.title: Can I study Aerospace Engineering in Switzerland after 12th?
sections.lead: After Class 12, you can go for relevant engineering studies, but dedicated bachelor’s programs specifically called Aerospace Engineering are limited. Mechanical engineering is a common alternative basis for later aerospace specialization.

sections.title: How long will it take to become an aerospace engineer in Switzerland?
sections.lead: A typical route is a three-year bachelor’s degree followed by a specialized master’s degree, which can take another 1.5–2 years depending on the program.

sections.title: Does Aerospace Engineering require IELTS in Switzerland?
sections.lead: No, not at all. Many bachelor’s programs are mainly taught in German or French, so you may need the corresponding language certificate instead. English-language requirements vary according to program, especially at master’s level.
